verdict.rationale: Airbyte publishes a pricing page with credit-based tiers, a free trial (400 credits ≈ $2,000 usage) and feature gates like SSO/RBAC (airbyte-docs-29, airbyte-docs-49, airbyte-docs-50), but the model is usage/credit-based rather than a transparent per-connector cost calculator, so estimating a specific new source's cost before connecting it isn't evidenced. Community feedback also notes confusing paid-vs-free boundaries and poor billing support responsiveness (airbyte-comm-2, airbyte-comm-9), undermining confidence in predictability. Missing for 10: a documented cost-estimation tool or per-source pricing calculator, and independent confirmation that credit consumption is predictable in practice.
